store_items.name: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods

extra_details.content_survey_notes: The game contains dark fantasy violence, combat involving weapons and supernatural creatures, descriptions of injuries and death, and scenes involving a cult. The story includes six children being forcibly kidnapped, threatened, and placed in danger. The game also contains frightening imagery and bleak horror themes. There is no sexual content or graphic gore.
extra_details.content_survey_ai_notes: Generative AI is used in both pre-generated and live-generated content. AI-assisted tools were used during development to create the game’s artwork, music, and sound effects. The game also uses live generative AI to produce narrative text during gameplay in response to predefined player choices, combat outcomes, character conditions, and equipment selections. All pre-generated assets were reviewed and selected by the developer before being included in the game.

During the development process, we may use procedural- and AI-based tools to assist with content creation. In all such cases, the final product reflects the creativity and expression of our own development team.
Our team uses generative AI tools to help develop some in game assets.

extra_details.content_survey_notes: This game contains adult content including frequent nudity, sexual dialog, sexual scenes/scenarios, references to drug/alcohol use, and anime boobies.
